# Helvety Notes

> Notes management with client-side encryption for title and description; the in-app list groups notes by fixed categories (Personal, Work, Other). The main list can be filtered in the browser after unlock by title and description (local-only search; not sent to servers). Engineered, Designed & Made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URL
- [Notes App](https://helvety.com/notes): Auth-required notes route

## Crawling And Indexing
- Notes routes are intended not to be indexed.
- These routes are not intended as crawl targets and are protected by noindex metadata and authentication controls.
